atomicityDefinition: Each action has one bounded reviewed intent, exact predecessor state and independently retained terminal evidence. This does not assert a filesystem-wide transaction or atomic ownership of a service label.
evidenceUnitRequired: exact host/product and prior original source pointers
expected after state and exclusive write custody if mutating
one stable action key and original absolute deadline
actual request/response or manager observation, with secrets projected or hashed
authoritative exit/complete stdout+stderr hashes and full original SDK
all owned child/FD/connection closure, original before-after fences
independent readback of any published immutable evidence
